scenarios.prompt: Create a skill that summarises a GitHub PR's diff and open review comments into a short status report.
expected_behavior: Asks, in one round, for the skill name (with a cyrus- suggestion), the invocation mode (implicit/explicit/background) and the target platforms (default Claude Code, Copilot, Codex), even though the prompt implies answers
Places it in skills/<name>/ when run inside cyrus-pal
Scaffolds with scripts/init_skill.py passing --invocation and --platforms instead of writing the folder by hand
Records cyrus-platforms and cyrus-invocation in metadata
Writes a third-person description containing what it does and 'Use when ...' triggers
Uses only spec frontmatter fields unless it explains why an extension is needed
Runs scripts/validate_skill.py and repeats until it passes
Fills evals/evals.json and adds a row to the AGENTS.md skills index

scenarios.prompt: This skill uses $ARGUMENTS and ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} and works in Claude Code. Make it work in Codex and Copilot too.
files: a third-party SKILL.md that uses Claude Code-only substitutions
expected_behavior: Runs the validator with --third-party and reports the Claude Code-only syntax warnings
Asks which platforms to target and records cyrus-platforms and cyrus-invocation
Replaces substitutions with plain-language instructions and paths relative to the skill directory
Keeps the skill name unchanged and bumps metadata.version
Re-runs the validator until it passes

scenarios.prompt: Make a skill that deploys the staging environment. It should only ever run when I explicitly ask.
expected_behavior: Still asks for name, invocation and platforms, proposing explicit invocation as the default
Sets disable-model-invocation: true for Claude Code and Copilot and explains claude.ai/API uploads cannot be targeted
Creates agents/openai.yaml with policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false when Codex is a target
Uses exact, low-freedom commands for the deploy step with a verification step

scenarios.prompt: Make a Claude Code-only skill that takes an issue number as an argument and drafts a fix plan.
expected_behavior: Records cyrus-platforms: "claude-code" and places a non-cyrus-pal skill in .claude/skills/
May use Claude Code-only features such as argument substitution and argument-hint; the validator does not warn about them
Does not create agents/openai.yaml
